ci_runs.summary: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed. Target Servo bootstrap, feature-boundary validation, Mesa, package, and kernel builds passed; Build Nagi user init is in progress. No M17 QEMU or pixel result yet.

Pinned Servo bootstrap passed on Ubuntu and target. Ubuntu format passed. Windows host build, Ubuntu locked Clippy, and target feature-boundary verification failed because the root Cargo.lock lacked servo-paint-api -> libc; Mesa and M17 QEMU were skipped. Main commit 5b2d235 adds the missing lock edge; public CI #187 is verifying that repair.
Ubuntu, Windows, and target Servo bootstrap failed because the direct servo-paint-api -> libc dependency had not yet been added to Servo pinned Cargo.lock; patch 0009 fixed that for CI #186.

Ubuntu and Windows jobs passed. Target build/link and persistent storage passed; the guest acquired its Surface, then QEMU timed out after `GL context creation started`. No pixel checksum or pass marker was produced.
M17 two-boot persistence checks passed, then software GL context setup timed out after 120 seconds; no Servo pixel was accepted.

acceptance_criteria: A clean clone can identify its current 0.2 workstream, current Git HEAD, last verified SHA, blocker, and exact next action from tracked state.
The registry/state validator rejects missing fields, invalid status or failure classes, duplicate IDs/branches, unsafe state paths, and missing dependencies.
The diagnostic command retains raw logs, inventories every undefined symbol and error line, records process status, and hashes logs/artifacts.
Existing 0.1 M17 acceptance criteria and runtime sources remain unchanged.
A single target run is not canceled by a newer push; cheap host jobs can cancel stale runs; CI diagnostic logs are retained when available.
Focused CLI tests, shell syntax checks, JSON/schema checks, and clean-worktree verification pass.
